checks.name: V1.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: Scalar 2 is nonzero; C is invariant. Multiplication by 3 gives the inverse.

checks.name: V2.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: A(te1)=2te1 for all t. The answer concerns C only; A is not one scalar on the entire ambient space.

checks.name: V3.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: The declared line has scalar 2 action even though the ambient matrix is not diagonal. No ambient eigenspace decomposition is required.

checks.name: V4.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: Restriction to C is the identity. The ambient kernel does not intersect C nontrivially; ambient noninjectivity alone does not invalidate this restriction.

checks.name: N1.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: Ae1=e2 is outside C, so the restriction is not a self-map of C.

checks.name: N2.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: f(0)=f(1); no nonzero scalar works. State separately that scalar 0 and additivity are valid.

checks.name: N3.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: f(0)=1, so it is not scalar or origin-preserving. It is nevertheless a permutation; do not conflate the two predicates.

checks.name: N4.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: A single scalar would be 2 from e1 and 3 from e2. This rejects only the claimed whole-space scalar action.

checks.name: U1.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: Both completions obey every stated premise; the informal presence of eigenlines does not select C.

checks.name: U2.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: Scalar action is already known; the unanswered clause is the nonzero/permutation requirement.

checks.name: U3.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: A permutation for every b need not be a group endomorphism.

checks.name: U4.oracle_obligation_present
checks.observed: Do not silently keep a characteristic-dependent equality when changing fields.

limitations: The verifier does not rerun evaluate.py or any scientific experiment; it independently derives all finite predicates from fixtures.json.
Original launch dirty-tree state, wall time, CPU time, and peak RSS cannot be remeasured from frozen artifacts; validation checks their internal consistency, bounds, and snapshot custody.

Serialized outputs cannot alone prove temporal ordering. The committed producer source places oracle loading after raw-card construction, and the receipt flags that order, but original runtime chronology is not independently observable.
The finite F_2/F_5 fixtures are toy controls and license no elliptic-curve, cryptographic-parameter, asymptotic, or hypothesis-status conclusion.
